title: Re - Arrest Of One Joao Thomaz DAquino Collaco, Portuguese

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
426
Date 3-2-44
Station Foreign Affairs Sect. File No. Date 2-2-44.
SUBJECT: Re Arrest of one Joao Thomaz D'Aquino Collaco
Portuguese
On 31-1-44 a Warrant of Arrest against one named
Joao Thomaz D'Aquino Collaco, Portuguese, was Received
from the Portuguese Consulate. Address was given as
Lane 401/60 Dent Road. Same date the place was visited
by D.I. Gigarson and D.S.I. Beloshenko but Collaco was
not at home.
At 10 a.m. on 1-2-44, the place was visited again
by D.S.I. Kramer and the undersigned Collaco was located
and brought to the offices.
As per arrangement, at 3 p.m. even date, Collaco
was brought before the Acting Consul General for Portugal
and then it was learned that Collaco is wanted on a
Charge of Breach of Confidence.
After questioning a Committal Order was issued for
Collaco to be detained in the Shanghai Gaol pending
trial in Portuguese Court.
At 5.30 p.m. same date Collaco was removed to the
Gaol.
D.S.I. Beloshenko, A.
Officer i/c Foreign Affairs.
（批：also see 外事二一六號）
（批：華文報告 入了）
（印：□）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
426
日期 1944年2月3日
所属部门 外事科 档案号 日期 1944年2月2日。
事由：关于逮捕一名若昂·托马斯·达基诺·科拉库（Joao Thomaz D'Aquino Collaco）
葡萄牙籍
1944年1月31日，收到葡萄牙领事馆签发的针对一名名为若昂·托马斯·达基诺·科拉库（Joao Thomaz D'Aquino Collaco）的葡萄牙人的逮捕令。提供的地址为登特路（Dent Road）401弄60号。同日，警探长吉加森（Gigarson）和副警探长别洛申科（Beloshenko）前往该址，但科拉库不在家。
1944年2月1日上午10时，副警探长克拉默（Kramer）与本人再次前往该址，找到科拉库并将其带至警局办公室。
按照安排，于当日下午3时，将科拉库带见葡萄牙代理总领事，此时获悉科拉库因被控违反信任罪（Breach of Confidence）而遭通缉。
经讯问后，签发拘押令，将科拉库羁押于上海监狱，等候葡萄牙法院审判。
同日下午5时30分，科拉库被移送至监狱。
副警探长 A. 别洛申科（A. Beloshenko），
外事科主管警官。
（批：also see 外事二一六號）
（批：華文報告 入了）
（印：□）
